about: transfers' application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk4-cancel-ignored
mutants.from:
case (Sending as x, Cancel):
		Enter[Transfer]{Next: Cancelled{MB: x.MB}}
mutants.to:
case (Sending as x, Cancel):
		Stay[Transfer]{Next: x}
mutants.rule: A cancel ends a sending transfer's entry, and with it the transfer.

mutants.name: fk4-restart-from-sent
mutants.rule: Only a cancelled transfer restarts (law RestartOnlyFromCancelled).

mutants.name: fk4-timer-one-mb-late
mutants.rule: A transfer arrives after its whole file, PerMB a megabyte (law ArrivesAfterTheWholeFile).

mutants.name: fk4-cancelall-skips-first
mutants.rule: Cancel all cancels every sending transfer (law CancelAllLeavesNoneRunning).

mutants.name: fk4-id-repeated
mutants.rule: Each start gets a new id (law IdsNeverReused).

mutants.name: fk4b-restart-any
mutants.rule: Shape B restarts a stopped entry only, as shape A does (law ShapesAgree).

mutants.name: fk4b-notfound-stops
mutants.to:
case NotFound:
			Stay[Uploads]{Next: setStatus(u, a.ID, Stopped)}
mutants.rule: A NotFound answer changes nothing: a cancel after completion keeps the transfer sent (law ShapesAgree).

mutants.name: fk4b-registry-tie
mutants.rule: A job due at the time of a press completes before the press, as the live board's timer fires before it (law ShapesAgree).

mutants.name: fk4b-view-restart-keeps-due
mutants.from: return Row{ID: r.ID, File: r.File, Transfer: next, Run: r.Run + 1, Due: None}
mutants.to: return Row{ID: r.ID, File: r.File, Transfer: next, Run: r.Run + 1, Due: r.Due}
mutants.rule: A restart sends the whole file again from the restart (law ShapesAgree, cases).

mutants.name: fk4b-view-latest-first
mutants.rule: The desk's work wakes for the first due row, so each row arrives at its own time (law ShapesAgree, cases).

mutants.name: fk4b-view-cancel-all-always
mutants.rule: Cancel all is on the screen only while a transfer sends, as upstream's (case scenes).

mutants.name: fk4b-view-empty-always
mutants.rule: The empty line shows only when there is no transfer (cases).

mutants.name: fk4b-view-restart-labelled-cancel
mutants.rule: A cancelled row's button is named Restart upload ID, as upstream's aria-label (case scenes, law ShapesAgree).

mutants.name: fk4c-same-key-drops-state
mutants.rule: A row's Same key holds all it shows: a row whose transfer changed runs again (cases, law ShapesAgree).

mutants.name: fk4c-same-removed
mutants.rule: A press runs only the rows it changed, so its work is flat in the rows (UI HOT PATHS; test PressWorkIsFlat, the only killer: no output changes).
